title: Wooden Item Frames
description: A datapack that lets you craft Item Frames from every wood type.
body:
![Datapack Logo / Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2983f53fe7922ea0e1e96b5cdf1c1925399f9a2d.png)

## About the Datapack
**Wooden Item Frames** is a datapack that adds 12 variants of the Item Frame made from all of the various wood types you can find in Minecraft.

They can be crafted by combining an Item Frame with Wooden Planks of your choosing in a Crafting Table, and can be used for decoration, item management, and more. 

**Wooden Item Frames** is available in 22 languages. You can find them in the list below.

<details>
<summary>Supported Languages</summary>

- English (US and UK)
- Spanish (Spain and Mexico)
- Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil)
- French
- Chinese (Traditional and Simplified)
- Hindi
- Arabic
- Filipino
- Russian
- Korean
- German
- Polish
- Italian
- Ukrainian

Plus 4 Joke Languages:
- Upside Down English
- Pirate Speak
- Shakespearean English
- LOLCAT
</details>

![Item Frames Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34c6f502a73ba039838750db925f5bb2b1da47fa.png)

## FAQ

**Q:** How can I disable the "Loaded succesfully!" message?
> **A:** Add the [No HFD Load Popups](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-hfd-popups) datapack to your datapack/mod folder.

**Q:** The pack doesn't work! / I don't see the "datapack loaded succesfully!" message!
> **A:** You're on a Minecraft version that doesn't support the pack. Check the [versions tab](https://modrinth.com/datapack/wif/versions) for compatible Minecraft versions.

**Q:** The Item Frames have missing textures / models!
> **A:** You don't have the resourcepack installed. You can find it in specific versions in the [versions tab](https://modrinth.com/datapack/wif/versions).

**Q:** Will you backport the datapack to an older version such as 1.XX?
> **A:** I can not reliably backport the datapack to versions lower than 1.20.5 because it uses the [_components_ field](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Data_component_format#Item_format) in recipe outputs, which was added in 1.20.5.

**Q:** I have multiple Item Frames of the same material that won't stack together!
> **A:** You have used the pack on an older version of the game, and then changed your Minecraft version. You can place all Item Frames down and break them again to update their data.
